chunks: Ali ibn Abdallah al-Warraq narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn Abdallah ibn Abi Khalaf al-Ash'ari narrated to us. He said: al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq al-Nahdi narrated to us from al-Husayn ibn 'Ulwan from 'Amr ibn Khalid from Sa'd ibn Tarif from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata. He said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) say:

I am the master of the children of Adam, and you, O Ali, and the Imams from your descendants, are the masters of my nation. Whoever loves us has loved God, and whoever hates us has hated God, and whoever aligns with us has aligned with God, and whoever opposes us has opposed God, and whoever obeys us has obeyed God, and whoever disobeys us has disobeyed God.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ مِنْ بَعْدِكَ: The Imams from your descendants — referring to the twelve Imams from the lineage of Ali and Fatima
key_terms.سَادَةُ أُمَّتِي: Masters of my nation — affirming the Imams' authority over the Muslim community
key_terms.سَيِّدُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ: Master of the children of Adam — a Prophetic title affirming the Prophet's supreme rank over all of humanity
key_terms.عَادَانَا: To oppose/be hostile to us — indicating enmity toward the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.وَالَانَا: To align with us / to take us as guardians (wala') — a technical term for the spiritual and political allegiance owed to the Imams

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the status of Imam Ali and the Imams in relation to God?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (saww) declares his supreme station as master of all humanity, and then elevates Imam Ali (as) and the subsequent Imams as the masters of the Muslim community. The hadith establishes a direct equivalence between one's relationship to the Ahl al-Bayt and one's relationship to God — loving, obeying, or opposing the Imams is tantamount to loving, obeying, or opposing God Himself. This statement was addressed directly to Imam Ali in the presence of al-Asbagh ibn Nubata, a close companion, and would have been understood as a comprehensive doctrinal declaration about the divine authority invested in the Imamate.
word_analysis: aligns with us/is loyal to us
